::: {.ref-description}
By default it reads the segmented cells (per-cell count matrix and cell
boundary polygons) that Space Ranger 4.x writes to `segmented_outputs/`. Set
`--mode bins` to instead read a binned output (`binned_outputs/square_<N>um/`)
at the bin size given by `--bin_size`. In both cases the loaded table is
renamed to "table" so that downstream components stay technology-agnostic.
:::


## Argument group

### Arguments

::::: {.arg-table role="table"}
:::: {.arg-row .arg-head role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="columnheader"}
Name

Description

Attributes

:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--input`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Input folder containing the output from a Space Ranger run for Visium HD
and a `*_feature_slice.h5` file. Must contain a `segmented_outputs/`
directory for `--mode segmented_cells`, or `binned_outputs/` for
`--mode bins`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"spaceranger_output"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Zarr directory where the SpatialData object will be stored.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`file` [required]{.arg-required}

[Example]{.arg-key} `"visium_hd_data.zarr"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--mode`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Which output to load into the table: `segmented_cells` (per-cell counts
and cell boundary polygons from `segmented_outputs/`) or `bins` (binned
counts from `binned_outputs/square_<bin_size>um/`).
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"segmented_cells"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"segmented_cells"`, `"bins"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--bin_size`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Bin size in microns to load when `--mode bins`. Visium HD captures data at
2 µm and aggregates it into 8 µm and 16 µm square bins.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`integer`

[Default]{.arg-key} `8`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `2`, `8`, `16`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_type`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Which count matrix to load: `filtered` (barcodes under tissue only) or
`raw` (all barcodes). Applies to both the segmented-cell and binned matrices.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`

[Default]{.arg-key} `"filtered"`

[Choices]{.arg-key} `"filtered"`, `"raw"`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--output_layer`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
If provided, the count matrix is also stored as a named layer
(`table.layers[output_layer]`) in addition to `.X`.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::: {.arg-row role="row"}
::: {.arg-name role="cell"}
`--dataset_id`
:::
::: {.arg-desc role="cell"}
Identifier used to name the spatial elements (shapes and images) in the
SpatialData object. If not provided, it is inferred from the
`*_feature_slice.h5` file name in the input directory.
:::
::: {.arg-attrs role="cell"}
`string`
:::
::::
:::::

## Example commands

You can run the pipeline using `nextflow run`.

### View help

You can use `--help` as a parameter to get an overview of the possible parameters.

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_spaceranger_hd_to_spatialdata/main.nf \
  --help
```

### Run command

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Create a params.yaml"}
The command below reads this component's arguments from a `params.yaml` file. To create one:

- generate it with the form on [Viash Hub](https://www.viash-hub.com/packages/openpipeline_spatial/v0.7.0/components/convert/from_spaceranger_hd_to_spatialdata);
- see examples of using params files in the [guides](/guides/index.qmd);
- run several samples in one go with a [`param_list`](/guides/process-many-samples.qmd).
:::

Run locally with:

```bash
nextflow run openpipelines-bio/openpipeline_spatial \
  -r v0.7.0 -latest \
  -profile docker \
  -main-script target/nextflow/convert/from_spaceranger_hd_to_spatialdata/main.nf \
  -params-file params.yaml
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="Other backends and platforms"}
Replace `-profile docker` with `-profile podman` or `-profile singularity` depending on the desired backend. To run on Seqera Platform or through Viash Hub, see the [guides](/guides/index.qmd).
:::
